versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Architecture Decision Record (ADR) skill:

- Generates comprehensive ADRs using the industry-standard Nygard format.
- Guides users through required context, options, decision, consequences, and review triggers.
- Ensures documentation of honest tradeoffs and rejected alternatives, not just the chosen path.
- Includes a detailed scoring rubric and anti-pattern checks to maintain ADR quality.
- Output supports future team understanding by emphasizing context and explicit problem statements.
